findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Katika siku za mwisho za mtume Yohana”
findings.source_quote: “Christ sent a message to the church at Laodicea, through him.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the sentence opening with: “Katika siku za mwisho za mtume Yohana, Kristo alituma ujumbe kwa kanisa la Laodikia kupitia kwake.”
findings.translation_quote: “Kristo alimtumia ujumbe kwa ajili ya kanisa la Laodikia.”

findings.location: Final prayer, sentence beginning “Nataka kuendelea kusoma”
findings.source_quote: “I want to move into the rest of this book with an open face before you.”
findings.suggested_fix: Use “Nataka kuendelea na sehemu iliyobaki ya kitabu hiki nikiwa na uso usiofunikwa mbele zako.”
findings.translation_quote: “Nataka kuendelea kusoma kitabu hiki nikiwa na uso ulio wazi mbele zako.”
